Number of one-bedroom units rented = 280 * (1/4) = 70 units

Step 3: Calculate the number of two-bedroom units rented:
Number of two-bedroom units rented = Total rented units - Number of one-bedroom units rented
Number of two-bedroom units rented = 280 - 70 = 210 units

Step 4: Calculate the ratio of two-bedroom units to one-bedroom units:
The ratio of two-bedroom units to one-bedroom units is 6:1.
Let the number of one-bedroom units be x.
Then the number of two-bedroom units is 6x.

x + 6x = 490
7x = 490

Number of two-bedroom units = 6 * 70 = 420 units

Step 7: Calculate the number of two-bedroom units not rented:
Number of two-bedroom units not rented = Total two-bedroom units - Number of two-bedroom units rented
Number of two-bedroom units not rented = 420 - 210 = 210 units
